periods.location: Hagun Academy fourth training ground stands
periods.summary: Nene Saikyo speaks with Hagun student council officers after Ikki defeats Kirihara, identifying Ikki as a future selection threat.
periods.cause: Ikki's method of defeating Hunter's Forest is extraordinary enough to draw elite attention.
periods.process: Nene notes that Ikki might become a key challenger for the absent student council president. Student council members acknowledge his sharp claws while still comparing him to a mouse facing a lion.
periods.outcome: Ikki is foreshadowed as no longer a mere Worst One but a recognized contender.
periods.aftermath: Online or school discourse begins attaching the title Another One / Uncrowned Sword King to Ikki.
periods.significance: Foreshadows future elite opponents beyond volume 1 and marks Ikki's rise in reputation.
